mapper.select: SELECT ps.id AS "scheduleId", (SELECT CASE WHEN pdn.spec IS NOT NULL AND pdn.spec != '' THEN pdn.name || '(' || pdn.spec || ')' ELSE pdn.name END FROM products pdn WHERE pdn.code = ps.product_code) AS "productName", ps.order_qty AS "orderQty", (SELECT cln.name FROM clients cln WHERE cln.client_code = ps.client_code LIMIT 1) AS "clientName", pc.code AS "productCode", pc.spec AS "spec" FROM production_schedule ps LEFT JOIN products pc ON pc.code = ps.product_code WHERE ps.schedule_date = #{date} ORDER BY ps.sort_order, ps.id
